items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Jelly Roll Morton and those people.

ctx.x: Yeah. I feel like that right now, because they got it as entertainment only. You know? Because if you look at that, those trees that they have with the roots of jazz you know, down at the bottom they got Satchmo and Bix Beiderbecke, and then they got, you know, the different people you know. And they come on up with Barney Bigard and —
Jelly Roll Morton and those people.

Yes and all those people and they come on up then they get the bebop days you know, pre-bebop you know. But I’m telling you, Nat King Cole, Sammy Davis Junior, Miles Davis, even Sinatra, Tony Bennett, but we’re focusing on the black ones and, you know, Dexter Gordon and Doug Carn and all the rest, we’re on that same tree we’re just another jigaboo we’re just a higher level of fruit of the same tree is the way they look at it, you know? And that you know so at any given night they say, “[inaudible] What are we…
